title_sq: APARTAMENT 1+1 PER SHITJE TE MINE PEZA
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Mine Peza prane Prokurorise ofrohet apartament 1+1 per shitje.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin perdhe te nje ndertimi ekzistues pa ashensor.
Sip. e apartamentit eshte 50.75 m2 neto dhe organizohet ne: korridor, dhome gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, nje tualet.
Prona eshte e pershtatshme per investim si qira mujore\airbnb ose zyre\dyqan etj.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
description_en: A 1+1 apartment is offered for sale on Mine Peza Street near the Prosecutor's Office. The apartment is located on the ground floor of an existing building without an elevator. Sip. of the apartment is 50.75 m2 net and is organized in: corridor, bedroom, living room with kitchen area, a toilet. The property is suitable for investment as monthly rent\airbnb or office\shop etc. Has regular mortgage documentation.
